player_prompt.intro:
Countdown numbers game hi khel mek che! 
Goal: Number te +, -, *, / hmangin target thleng rawh.
Action format: [i j op] i,j index leh operation op anih avangin hmang rawh.
Example: [0 2 *] number index 0 leh index 2 te multiply a ni.
Division ah chuan number tlem ber a ni tur a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Index diklo. A danglam a, 0-{max_index} range chhunga awm tur a ni ang.
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Operation diklo (zero emaw integer result ni lo a sem)

outcome.win: A ṭha hle mai! Target dik tak chu hmu ta: {target}
outcome.no_moves: Move dang awm lo. He thleng ber: {best_value} (target: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit thleng tawh. He thleng ber: {best_value} (target: {target})
